<p>Are you poor, desperate, huddled, massive? Do you live in a dark age, a depression, one of the many historical periods of slim pickings and no options? Welcome to the TEMPS, the first cross-temporal employment app! The past and future are filled with low skill, low wage gigs! Gigs such as: Cobbler's assistant in plague-era Europe! Salvager in the ruins of New York, 2832! Soldier in Krang's Cross-Time Army! Temp is shattering the temporal ceiling!</p>
